name: Ring of Summoning Affinity (Angel)
body:
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 218
Aura faint conjuration [good] CL 5th
Slot ring; Price 7,200 gp; Weight —
Description
This ring is cut from transparent crystal. If the wearer can cast summon monster spells, the wearer adds cassianB2 to the 3rd-level list of monsters she can summon with those spells, adds movanic devaB2 to the 7th-level list, and adds monadic devaB2 to the 8th-level list. Also, once per day on command the wearer can use this ring to summon a cassian, as if by the summon monster III spell.
Construction
Requirements Forge Ring, planar ally or planar binding, creator must be good; Cost 3,600 gp
